rationale: Ground truth carries no substantive concerns (just LGTM approvals), so recall is trivially satisfied by both. X traces the actual code path (stage_input_processors, talker dummy-forward, serving_chat error handling) to show the PR's own 'silent audio' claim is likely wrong, catches an overbroad extra_body generalization with a concrete counter-example (GLM-Image.md), and proposes exact replacement text plus a runnable jq/base64 verification snippet — all highly grounded and directly actionable. Y's findings are thinner: one is framed as an unresolved question ('can you paste the choices array') rather than a verified claim, and the CI note largely duplicates X's but is more hedged. X's greater verification rigor and concrete fix suggestions make it clearly stronger.
